candidates.what_changed: Explains Claude Code's experimental Code Mode, where Claude writes JavaScript that makes several tool calls in one step instead of one tool call per turn.
candidates.mechanism: Per the description: enable with CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_CODE_MODE=1 claude on Claude Code 2.1.323+; links the official docs (code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode) and Cloudflare's Sept 2025 'Code Mode: the better way to use MCP' post, which originated the pattern. Docs confirm: one script can run commands in parallel, chain results, and return only what Claude needs; code shown via Ctrl+O as collapsed Code rows.
candidates.evidence_quality: Feed-verified title/URL/date; video contents not watched, only the (truncated) description. Feature itself verified against official docs and changelog.
candidates.independent_confirmation: Official Code Mode docs (dateModified 2026-11-16) and Claude Code changelog 2.1.326/2.1.327 entries on Code Mode (agent-teams support, $ shell helper hardening, mod-hook start fix, auto-mode script fix). Cloudflare blog (2025-09-26) for the concept.
candidates.relevance: high: concrete workflow change for daily Claude Code users; practitioners can try it today with one env var. 185k views in ~2 days signals strong interest.
candidates.overlap_with_prior: Edition 1 ran the Claude Code 2.1.325 changelog; Code Mode itself was not featured. New.
candidates.worth_watching: Whole video likely; chapter timestamps not readable from the feed. Pair with the docs' 'When to use' and 'limitations' sections.
candidates.summary: Ray Amjad's Nov 16 video argues Code Mode is the largest change to Claude Code's harness so far. Per the description it shows how to switch it on (CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_CODE_MODE=1, v2.1.323+) and points to the official docs and Cloudflare's original Code Mode/MCP work (Cloudflare's Code Mode MCP server reportedly collapses 2,600 tools into 2). The official docs (read) say: Code Mode is experimental and off by default; Claude writes JS using helpers like $`...` for shell and edit(); it suits repeated multi-file edits, searches needing filtering, and parallel independent commands. Limits: terminal-only interactive sessions (no -p, Agent SDK, VS Code panel, Desktop, cloud sessions), subscription or Console account only (no Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry/gateways), not HIPAA/ZDR orgs, models Opus/Sonnet/Haiku 5.5 or Fable 5.2, native build only, 10-minute cap on foreground code, auto mode's classifier reviews the code rather than each call, no Remote Control/Claude in Chrome/computer use, resume only with Code Mode on; project settings cannot turn it on (security), admins can block with value 0 in managed settings. Ray is a course seller; treat claims of 'biggest change' as opinion.

candidates.title: Claude Code 2.1.326
candidates.author: Anthropic
candidates.what_changed: Code Mode now works with agent teams; big permission/sandbox tightening; auto mode becomes the default when org policy hasn't loaded; /claude-api skill builds on Managed Agents by default.
candidates.mechanism: Added: Code Mode + agent teams (sessions with teams on now start in Code Mode if enabled); startup warning for incomplete --allowedTools/--disallowedTools rules; /status row for features turned off by provider/env; Ctrl+O shows hidden startup notices; OTEL_RESOURCE_INCLUDE_HOST. Changed: Code Mode $ shell helper refuses some values; sandboxed commands no longer write to sensitive home folders by default (sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite to allow); file tools refuse writes to .credentials.json; hook 'decision: block' holds in more cases (hooks that always print one may start blocking); worktree-isolated subagents refuse branch-rewriting git commands; --add-dir shows trust prompt for untrusted folders; automatic compaction in plan mode uses the answering model (e.g. Opus with opusplan) so can cost more; HIPAA config orgs start in auto mode by default; Remote Control uses CONNECT tunnels through proxies; self-hosted runners get built-in gh api via Anthropic by default.
candidates.evidence_quality: Primary source read directly (changelog page, dateModified 2026-11-17).
candidates.independent_confirmation: Code Mode docs page mentions v2.1.326 requirement for agent teams.
candidates.relevance: high for Claude Code users: several changes can break existing hooks/sandbox setups.
candidates.overlap_with_prior: Edition 1 covered 2.1.325; this is the next release.
candidates.summary: Large security-hardening release. Practitioner-relevant: (1) Code Mode can now be used with agent teams (teammates run in Code Mode in in-process display mode). (2) Hooks that print decision: block may now actually block more calls. (3) Sandbox stops writes to sensitive home folders and sets aside unexpected .git entries. (4) Plan-mode compaction may cost more with opusplan. (5) Default to auto mode if org policy fails to load. (6) /claude-api skill now defaults to Managed Agents.

candidates.title: Claude Code 2.1.327
candidates.author: Anthropic
candidates.what_changed: claude mcp add-json reads from stdin (keeps tokens off the command line); /status lists broken agents/skills/hooks; auto mode's billed-classifier fallback to be removed next release; Code Mode starts even with tool-call-hooking mods; VS Code 'Add to Chat' in Explorer.
candidates.mechanism: Added: `claude mcp add-json <name> -` stdin; /status list of broken agent, skill, command, output-style files, keybinding errors, unavailable sandbox, ignored permission settings and never-matching hook matchers; /config override notes; attributionProject setting for billing groups; /tui classic. Changed: confirmation before /install-github-app changes a repo; ExitWorktree asks before removing worktree with unsaved work; auto mode ignores more 'run any package' allow rules like Bash(pnpm dlx *); auto mode notice says an upcoming release removes the billed classifier fallback; Code Mode no longer refuses to start with tool-call-hooking mods; subagent progress summaries on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry use far fewer tokens; first Bash command faster because shell start-up files may run before approval (CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_SHELL_HEAD_START=1 to turn off); long replies on unrecognized models continue at 128k after a 32k cut. Fixes include a Code Mode script in auto mode getting prompts once a second script started.
candidates.relevance: high: /status diagnostics and mcp add-json stdin are immediately useful; shell head-start is a behavior change worth flagging.
candidates.summary: Quality-of-life plus security. Most useful for readers: /status now surfaces broken skills/agents/hooks and hook matchers that never match; MCP servers can be added from JSON on stdin so secrets stay out of shell history; auto mode will soon stop falling back to billed classifier requests (actions will be asked or denied). Note the shell-startup change: start-up files may run before the first Bash command is approved.
